Piyush Goyal to visit US for G20 talks on critical minerals

Union Minister Piyush Goyal is scheduled to travel to the United States later this month to participate in G20 discussions. The focus of these talks will be on global pacts concerning critical minerals, according to Ambassador Sergio Gor. India is actively engaged in negotiations for these international agreements.
